blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Office of the Ombudsman has denied a motion for reconsideration filed by Dalaguete, Cebu Mayor Ronald Allan Cesante, upholding his six-month suspension without pay over alleged irregularities in the construction of a municipal warehouse on a privately owned lot. Five other municipal officials were also covered by the administrative penalty. […]... Keep on reading: OMB upholds 6-month suspension of Dalaguete mayor, 5 others
